summary: Frontend E2E testing of AI Cost & Reliability Autopilot (Phase 1). First login attempt succeeded and Dashboard rendered REAL seeded data. Two blocking issues surfaced during the run: (1) Supabase Auth email provider became DISABLED mid-run (error_code=email_provider_disabled) preventing any further logins with either primary or secondary account; (2) Backend intermittently returns 500 on /api/projects and /api/analytics/events due to unhandled httpx.RemoteProtocolError from Supabase PostgREST — 500 causes react-dev webpack error overlay which blocks all subsequent UI interactions. Consequently, only Login, Dashboard, Sidebar navigation to Projects and Usage were exercised end-to-end; Costs, Reliability, Usage pagination, Projects create, Project Detail (API Keys reveal-once, revoke), Optimization, Settings, Seed toast, and Logout could NOT be re-verified because re-login is blocked by Supabase config.

critical.issue: Unhandled httpx.RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected from Supabase PostgREST propagates as raw 500. No retry/backoff and no graceful error envelope. Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (line ~391 in server.py analytics_events). Immediate retry succeeds so it is a transient upstream flake but blocks the UI.

minor.issue: Analytics/projects endpoints are declared as sync def with sync postgrest client; consider async client + a small retry (e.g. tenacity) around Supabase calls to survive transient RemoteProtocolError.

ui_bugs.issue: webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe covers the page when any Axios call returns 500, intercepting all pointer events (documented Playwright errors show <iframe id="webpack-dev-server-client-overlay"> intercepts pointer events). API errors should be caught in the API layer and surfaced as toasts/inline errors instead of throwing to the React error boundary in dev.

integration_issues.flow: Any page depending on /api/projects or /api/analytics/events (Projects, Usage, ProjectDetail)
integration_issues.issue: When backend flakes with 500 the page shows Uncaught runtime error overlay instead of a friendly retry state.

auth_config_issue.detail: Direct POST to https://wskobzcngdykubrbcgww.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password returns 422 {"code":422,"error_code":"email_provider_disabled","msg":"Email logins are disabled"} for BOTH founder@autopilot.test and intruder@autopilot.test. First login of the run worked, so the provider was toggled off (or auto-disabled) mid-session. Main agent must re-enable Email provider in Supabase project Auth > Providers, and keep email confirmation disabled for dev, before further frontend testing can proceed.

Request mentions chart-spend-timeseries and chart-requests-errors; actual code uses data-testid='chart-spend' and 'chart-requests' (Dashboard.js L60,L66).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py analytics_events (~L391) and list_projects (~L146) use sync postgrest client without any try/except or retry — a single Supabase TCP disconnect surfaces as a raw 500 to the frontend. Wrap Supabase queries with a small retry (2 attempts, 250 ms) and return a structured 503 with a message so the UI can show 'retry' UX.
React dev-mode overlay swallows the whole page on unhandled Axios rejections. The api client should catch errors and dispatch to a toast/error boundary so users can continue interacting.

Provider config drift: frontend depends on Supabase email/password but that provider is currently disabled in the Supabase project — this is not defensively surfaced to the user. Login form should render the Supabase error message body when signInWithPassword rejects.
action_items: URGENT: Re-enable Email provider in Supabase (Auth > Providers > Email) — currently disabled; blocks all logins.
Add retry + graceful error handling around all sync postgrest calls in backend/server.py (analytics_events, list_projects, and every /api/analytics/*) to survive RemoteProtocolError.
Surface API errors as UI toasts instead of letting Axios rejections bubble to React error boundary / webpack overlay.
Reconcile data-testid naming between docs and code (kpi-success vs kpi-success-rate; chart-spend/chart-requests vs chart-spend-timeseries/chart-requests-errors).
After re-enabling Auth, rerun full frontend E2E for Costs, Reliability, Usage pagination, Projects create, ProjectDetail API-key reveal-once + revoke, Optimization placeholder, Settings save, Logout.

rca_of_the_issue: Two independent problems compounded: (a) Backend synchronous postgrest calls in server.py do not tolerate Supabase's occasional HTTP/2 disconnects — httpx raises RemoteProtocolError which FastAPI turns into a bare 500. Repro: hit /api/projects or /api/analytics/events repeatedly; observe intermittent failure in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log and 200 on immediate retry. Mitigation: wrap each supabase.table().select().execute() in a helper with 2 retries and 250 ms backoff, and return HTTPException(503) with a clear message on final failure. (b) Supabase project has Email provider disabled — every signInWithPassword returns 422 email_provider_disabled. Repro: curl -X POST supabase/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with valid creds. Mitigation: toggle Email provider ON in Supabase dashboard (Auth > Providers) and keep 'Confirm email' off for dev.
